short: Natural Healing Acupuncture offers holistic healing solutions through Traditional Chinese Medicine in a warm and welcoming environment. Located in Los Angeles, CA, the clinic specializes in fertility acupuncture and provides a wide range of services including acupuncture, herbal medicine, cupping therapy, moxibustion, electro-acupuncture, and nutritional guidance. Whether you're seeking support for fertility, women’s health, pain management, digestive issues, anxiety, or stress relief, Natural Healing Acupuncture delivers personalized care to restore balance and promote long-term wellness. For those looking for expert fertility acupuncture in Los Angeles, CA, this clinic provides compassionate, results-driven treatment tailored to your individual needs.
certs: FABORM (Fellow of the American Board of Oriental Reproductive Medicine); Hunyuan Fertility Method Certified; Clinical Excellence in Fertility Program; Fertile Soul affiliate; American Society of Reproductive Medicine / RESOLVE.
training: Bachelor of Science in Exercise Kinesiology, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), 1985. Master’s Degree in Traditional Chinese Medicine, Emperor’s College, Santa Monica, California, 1994. Doctorate, Pacific College of Health and Science, 2022. Also completed 3-1/2 months of study and clinical treatment of patients at a hospital in Shanghai, China.

long: Natural Healing & Acupuncture is an integrative Chinese medicine practice serving West Los Angeles and Santa Monica. The practice combines Traditional Chinese Medicine with nutritional and medical science to create individualized health and wellness plans. Services include acupuncture, Chinese herbal medicine, nutrition, functional laboratory testing, and integrative care. Areas of focus include fertility, IVF and IUI support, women's health, pain management, cancer support, and overall health and wellness. Telemedicine services are also available for eligible consultations and coaching.
size: Continue providing personalized care to patients while maintaining a sustainable practice and serving patients in West Los Angeles, Santa Monica, and surrounding areas.
